Vallabhācārya_I
alias Vallabha alias Vallabha Dīkṣita with the epithet Vaiśvānara or Agni, was a son of Lakṣmaṇa Bhaṭṭa an. Yallamā, elder brother of Rāmacandra, an. father of Gopīnātha an. Viṭṭhala. He was born in 1479 C.E. in the forest of Chamba near Raipur. He was the preceptor of Puruṣottama, a. of Avatāravādāvalī, etc.), contemporary of Kṛṣṇadeva Rāya of Viajayanagara. He was the founder of Śuddhādvaita school.
See TRC. Thesis, p.. 76-77; also S. N. Dasgupta, His.. of Indan Phil. IV. p. 373.
